text:
jordan: Quick design check  threshold expression editor. debating inline compact builder vs opening a modal for advanced expressions. figma: https://figma.com/file/thresholds. which feels less intimidating for new users?
anika: inline is faster for simple rules (rate > 5%). modal is cleaner for complex boolean combos. maybe hybrid: inline simple, 'Advanced' opens modal.
rachel: hybrid sounds good. UI nit: inline tokens look cramped when you add multiple conditions. suggest token spacing + reduce token rounded radius.
tyler: agree on spacing. also keyboard entry: tokens should be creatable via Enter and removable with Backspace when empty. aria-bot: keyboard guidance: ensure role='list' for token container and each token has tabindex=0 for focus.
anika: copy suggestion: change placeholder from 'e.g. rate > 5%' to 'Try: requests.rate > 5% over 5m'  more explicit about metric and window.
jordan: good call. also think about the helper text under the field: current text is long and wraps oddly on small widths. propose we collapse to one line: 'Use metric.field and comparison (>, <, >=).' with a learn link.
rachel: accessibility: low-contrast divider in the editor area is at 2.8:1. bump to hit 3:1 min for separation. I'll post palette token.
tyler: modal version needs preview of matched examples (sample payloads) so users can validate their expression. where to place that preview? right side panel or below?
anika: side rail for desktop, below on mobile. keep it collapsible.
jordan: UX flow thought: start inline, show subtle 'Advanced' CTA if user types '(' or 'AND/OR' and display 'Open advanced editor' hint.
rachel: should we persist last used mode per user? some power users always use advanced.
anika: whoops typo: anika: yes, persist mode in local storage and account settings.
tyler: implementation note: token parser should be resilient to stray punctuation and show inline validation with color and icon, not a blocking modal.
aria-bot: Accessibility check: when tokens change, announce via aria-live region: 'Expression updated: 2 conditions'. focus management required when opening advanced modal (move focus into dialog).
jordan: action items: rachel adjusts spacing + contrast, anika updates placeholder copy and figma variants, tyler prototypes keyboard/remove behavior and sample payload preview panel, I'll draft a short spec for hybrid behavior and persistence. target: mock + a11y pass by Wed. thanks :thumbsup:
